calculations.original_public_message: Calculate leased percentage = (total leased square feet / total facilities square feet) * 100, using source table totals.

raw_final: Approximately 14.46% of total facilities square footage is leased. Calculation: 8.1 million sq ft leased ÷ 56.0 million sq ft total × 100 = 14.4643%. Source: table totals from INTC 2015 Form 10-K page 41.
